posts.body:
Hello, my work colleague is finishing up for maternity leave and she has hinted that she would like a baby gym as her baby present.

Does anyone have any recommendations for a decent one?

We should have quite a decent pot from the collection, so would like to buy a good quality / branded one, thanks !

posts.body:
We have this one. http://www.fisher-price.com/en_GB/brands/babygear/products/42526 (fisher price rainforest gym). It's about £50.

The music drives you crazy after a while, but it's the same with all toys. She loves batting at the toys dangling down and you can change them or add more as required.

posts.body:
We've had a couple in the past...

http://www.mothercare.com/Bright-Starts-Deluxe-Baby's-Playplace/479125,default,pd.html was nice in terms of having the sides raised to start but then evolving into a playmat - however the design of it like that made it a nightmare in terms of collecting fluff in the velcro etc and with two kids the eldest regularly would dive bomb the sides on it.

http://www.amazon.co.uk/gp/product/B004DBA4OE/ref=pd_lpo_sbs_dp_ss_2?pf_rd_p=103612307&pf_rd_s=lpo-top-stripe&pf_rd_t=201&pf_rd_i=B000TFLMVM&pf_rd_m=A3P5ROKL5A1OLE&pf_rd_r=0EWB7RNFD9EA1NZVSB1T had that one with my youngest - despite my utter aversion to buying things completely pink for little girls I picked it as the mat underneath it was really nicely padded and it was generally better quality than the primary coloured "boys" version I would have usually gone for. It's still serving good duty underneath our jumperoo cushioning the base of the frame in case the littlest one rolls onto it and bumps her head and it's survived a LOT of washing and puking on thanks to the neverending reflux queen! Was planning on using it as a rug in the summer house once we'd finished with it as well as when you take the arches off it'll quite easily pass for one.

I'd avoid this one: http://www.mamasandpapas.com/product-elfie-mop-playmat-gym/759421800/type-i/

posts.body: We had this Baby Einstein Caterpillar and Friends play gym, and my little lady loved it. She continued playing with the toys long after she'd outgrown the playmat - we'd clip them onto the pushchair and the car seat. Would definitely recommend.
